subject.title: [RFC] Agent Teleconference — minimum-viable scoped meeting primitive with working prototype

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core meeting lifecycle primitive above existing session delivery and handoff surfaces, and if so which storage, authorization, and transcript model should it use?
rationale: The request is concrete but would define core CLI/API behavior, persistent state, transcript privacy, and cross-agent authorization boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve Scoped Core Lifecycle
options.body: Accept a narrow core meeting layer only after storage, authorization, transcript, and handoff-contract decisions are written down for the implementation PR.

options.title: Route Through Plugin First
options.body: Require the prototype to live as a plugin or ClawHub path until a missing core/plugin API is proven and narrowed.

options.title: Close As Too Broad For Core
options.body: Reject the core primitive for now because VISION.md prefers lean core and avoids heavy orchestration layers.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Core Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow core meeting layer only after storage, authorization, transcript, and handoff-contract decisions are written down for the implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He already supplied the maintainer-side scoping guidance on this issue and the lower-level handoff thread.
